323-401-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
323-401-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

654-851-3129-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

5261-6587-6588-7715.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

1170-2642-4050-7499.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Lluwen, Exchange Student // Pest Friend, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

646-1554-7439.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least 4 life.
You have a way to gain life available.
646-1554-7439.description:
Cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Gain at least 1 life by any method.
When you gain life, Dawn of Hope triggers.
Use Channel's ability three times by paying 3 life, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Words of Worship by paying {1}, creating a replacement effect.
Resolve the Dawn of Hope trigger, paying {2} and gaining 5 life instead of drawing a card due to the replacement effect.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily high life total, you may use Channel's ability any number of times, adding infinite colorless mana.

903-2199-4591.notablePrerequisites: Karplusan Minotaur and Platinum Angel have indestructible, protection from red or protection from creatures.
903-2199-4591.description:
Activate Frenetic Efreet an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Resolve a Frenetic Efreet ability, causing you to flip a coin.
Karplusan Minotaur triggers. If you won the flip, it deals 1 damage to any target you choose. If you lost the flip, it deals 1 damage to a target of an opponent's choosing. You cannot lose the game due to this damage due to Platinum Angel, and Karplusan Minotaur and Platinum Angel cannot be destroyed due to its indestructibility or protection.
Repeat from step 2.

413-628-7194.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Burdened Stoneback.
When Burdened Stoneback dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Burdened Stoneback enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

444-2042-2894-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-2042-2894-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Golgari Brownscale. Then, the draw will be replaced by Golgari Brownscale's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Golgari Brownscale from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2392-3814-6871.description:
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4050-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4050-6097.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

876-1170-1329-2478.description:
If needed, activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Emry.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1753-6188-6911.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent. There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1753-6188-6911.description:
Declare Fear of Missing Out as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Fear of Missing Out, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Fear of Missing Out that isn't legendary.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters, it triggers, causing you to rummage
During your next combat phase, declare Fear of Missing Out and the Fear of Missing Out token as attackers.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, causing you to untap the nontoken Fear of Missing Out and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2577-5670-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-6458.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1350-4231-6723-6724.description:
Cast The Goose Mother by paying at least {7}{G}{U}.
When The Goose Mother enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Clue, four Food and four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Foods, four Clues and four Treasures by tapping them, adding {9}{G}{W}{U}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning The Goose Mother from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4231-6723-6724.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {2} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo. Otherwise, the token results will be tapped tokens instead of untapped tokens. If you get infinite mana, you can cast The Goose Mother and put infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

658-3544-4050-4924-5751.description:
Cast Auramancer from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {W} and discarding Urza's Saga.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Urza's Saga from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Auramancer, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

2634-4668-5211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
2634-4668-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the Brass's Bounty copy, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
2634-4668-5211.notes: The number of lands needed can be reduced if opponents have drawn cards this turn due to Heliod.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it
with four or more quest counters on it

1495-4120-4522.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling the amount of damage sources you control deal this turn.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.
1495-4120-4522.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 3 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

546-2874-6287.notablePrerequisites: At least two additional creature cards in your graveyard.
546-2874-6287.description:
Cast Mimeoplasm by paying {4}{B}{G}{U}
As Mimeoplasm enters, exile Ramos, Heroes' Bane, and two additional creature cards from your graveyard, causing Mimeoplasm to enter with twelve +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Ramos with this ability.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Heroes' Bane with this ability.
Activate Mimeoplasm using Heroes' Bane's ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

3908-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Spark Double on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Spark Double do not have summoning sickness.
3908-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Spark Double.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Spark Double.
Activate Spark Double by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Spark Double ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

804-2092-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima the Impostor and Agatha of the Vile Cauldron each have a power of at least 2.
804-2092-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Sakashima the Impostor and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Sakashima the Impostor to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2097-4518-5554.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure token.
2097-4518-5554.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure token you control.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

116-624-2569.notablePrerequisites:
Phantasmal Image is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Phantasmal Image do not have summoning sickness.
116-624-2569.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Phantasmal Image.
Activate Phantasmal Image by tapping it.
When Phantasmal Image becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Phantasmal Image's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2060-4518-5115-5283.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
2060-4518-5115-5283.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

933-1558-1770-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2825-3205-4067-5126.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause an opponent to discard a card.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
You control at least one mana-producing permanent.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
2825-3205-4067-5126.description:
Cause an opponent to discard at least one card.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter twice by discarding Aurora Eidolon and another card, untapping Elite Arcanist and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Elite Arcanist by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Dream Salvage without paying its mana cost.
Aurora Eidolon triggers, returning itself to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve Dream Salvage, causing you to draw at least one card.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2421-3263-4005.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Syrix, adding {2}.
Choose not to move Syrix from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {2}.
Skyfire Phoenix dies, triggering Syrix, causing you to pay {4} to cast Syrix from your graveyard.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

856-1201-1636-4916.notablePrerequisites:
Animate Artifact attached to Witch's Oven.
Witch's Oven does not have summoning sickness.
856-1201-1636-4916.description:
Activate Witch's Oven by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, creating a Food token.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familar enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1300-2826-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Weaver of Harmony.
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other Shrines.
1300-2826-3525.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Repeat from step 2.

215-538-2397-4939.description:
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary for {R/G}{R/G}.
Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, triggering itself twice and Impact Tremors twice.
Resolve both Burning-Tree Emissary triggers, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}.
Resolve both Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Burning-Tree Emissary to your hand.
Repeat.
